_comment_password: Do NOT put a plaintext password here. Run 'kmitl-authen config' (it writes password_enc for you), or 'kmitl-authen protect' to convert an existing plaintext config. Schemes, strongest first: dpapi / dpapi-machine (Windows, real encryption), keyring (OS credential store), b64 (obfuscation only), plain.
_comment_ip: Leave ip_address out to auto-detect the source address toward the portal.
_comment_mac: Leave mac_address out to detect once and pin it in the state dir.
